description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named LoaderCustom and related classes for displaying and searching a list of installed applications using a custom Loader. It includes inner classes for data modeling (AppEntry), a custom loader (AppListLoader), an adapter (AppListAdapter), and a Fragment (AppListFragment) that manages the UI components like SearchView and list interactions.

classes.name: LoaderCustom
classes.description: Main activity that initializes the application list fragment and manages lifecycle.

classes.name: LoaderCustom.AppEntry
classes.description: Data model representing an application entry with methods to load icon and label, and toString override.

classes.name: LoaderCustom.AppListLoader
classes.description: Custom AsyncTaskLoader that loads installed applications with change monitoring.

classes.name: LoaderCustom.AppListAdapter
classes.description: ArrayAdapter to display application icon and label in list items.

classes.name: LoaderCustom.AppListFragment
classes.description: Fragment that displays the list of applications with search functionality, manages loader callbacks.

classes.name: LoaderCustom.MySearchView
classes.description: Custom subclass of SearchView to clear query when collapsed.

classes.name: LoaderCustom.PackageIntentReceiver
classes.description: BroadcastReceiver that monitors app package changes and triggers loader data refresh.

methods.name: loadInBackground
methods.description: Loads list of installed applications in background thread.

methods.name: deliverResult
methods.description: Delivers loaded data to UI thread.

methods.name: onStartLoading
methods.description: Starts the loader, triggers data load if needed.

methods.name: onStopLoading
methods.description: Stops the loader, cancels ongoing load.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets new data in the adapter.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list and loader, sets options menu.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Filters list based on search query.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates adapter data when load finishes.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears adapter when loader is reset.
